'''František Janouch''' (22 September 1931 – 12 January 2024) was a Czech [[Nuclear physics|nuclear physicist]], author and [[dissident]]. While still a high-school student in 1948, he joined the [[Communist Party of Czechoslovakia]]. He was later expelled and stripped of his citizenship at the time of [[Normalization (Czechoslovakia)|normalization]].<ref name=":0" /> In 1978 in Stockholm, he co-founded and chaired the Charter 77 Foundation to support Czechoslovak [[Charter 77]] signatories from abroad.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Fojtů |first=Martina |date=18 November 2014 |title=Staňte se občany, vyzval studenty chartista |url=https://www.em.muni.cz/udalosti/4986-stante-se-obcany-vyzval-studenty-chartista |access-date=13 January 2024 |website=em.muni.cz |language=cs}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
František Janouch died in [[Stockholm]], Sweden on 12 January 2024, at the age of 92.<ref>{{cite news |title=Charter 77 founder František Janouch dies at 92 |url=https://english.radio.cz/charter-77-founder-frantisek-janouch-dies-92-8805446 |access-date=13 January 2024 |publisher=Radio Prague International |date=12 January 2024}}</ref>

Janouch's daughter, [[Katerina Janouch]], is a Swedish journalist, far-right politician, and author.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Katerina Janouch |url=http://www.inthewordsof.com/katerina-janouch.html |access-date=13 January 2024 |website=In The Words Of |language=en}}</ref>
